candidates.change_summary: Remove the require check so the onlyOwner modifier no longer restricts the caller.
Flip the ownership condition so the modifier reverts when the caller IS the owner.
Withdraw zero instead of the full contract balance.
Delete the withdraw call so withdrawAll transfers no funds at all.
Remove the require(msg.sender == owner) check so anyone can call functions guarded by onlyOwner.
Always transfer the contract's entire balance instead of the requested _value.
Transfer 0 wei instead of _value, so the call sends no ether.
Replace the low-level call with transfer, which reverts on failure instead of silently continuing and forwards less gas.
Require the low-level call to succeed so failed calls revert rather than returning silently.
Delete the call statement so sendMoney performs no transfer at all.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier so any address can call sendMoney.
Invert the ownership check so only non-owners may pass the modifier.
Delete the require statement so the modifier imposes no restriction.
Invert the ownership check so only non-owners pass.
Remove the ownership check so anyone can call guarded functions.
Remove the withdrawal call so withdrawAll transfers no funds.
Withdraw a fixed amount of 1 wei instead of the full contract balance.
Replace the transfer amount `_value` with `address(this).balance` so withdraw always sends the full contract balance instead of the requested amount.
Replace the transfer amount `_value` with `0` so the call sends no ether.
Invert the onlyOwner check so withdraw can only be called by non-owners.
Replace the low-level call with transfer, so a failing or gas-limited target reverts / returns gas differently.
Delete the call statement so sendMoney sends no ether at all.
Invert the owner check so only non-owners may call the guarded functions.
